name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
June 11, 2024 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Rabbi Mark Goldfarb
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: La Mirada Community Foundation
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Otero
Mayor Pro Tem Eng
Mayor Lewis
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
RECOGNITION OF WOMEN OF THE YEAR IN COMMEMORATION OF WOMEN'S HISTORY MONTH - It is recommended the City Council present recognition plaques to Dr. Cathy Alvarez and Patty Miller for their valuable contributions to the community and for being selected as 2024 Women of the Year.
5.1 Women of the Year
5.2
RECOGNITION OF FORMER ADVISORY BODY MEMBERS - It is recommended the City Council present an appreciation plaque and tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts to Philip Massey and Raymond Fernandez for their years of dedicated service to the community.
5.2 Recognition of Former Advisory Body Members
5.3
INTRODUCTION OF NEW FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES - It is recommended the City Council welcome Jose Cortes and Simon Gonzalez and present them with a $40 gift certificate to Panera Bread restaurant, a voucher for two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, and two passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.
5.3 Introduction of City Employees
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
CITY COUNCIL APPOINTMENTS TO VARIOUS AGENCIES - It is recommended the Mayor make the necessary appointments of delegates and alternates to the various organizations on which members of the City Council participate.
7.1 City Council Appointments to Agencies
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of May 28, 2024.
8.1 Minutes of 5-28-24
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated June 11, 2024 in the total amount of $1,615,285.01.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
AWARD OF CONTRACT TO MV TRANSPORTATION, INC. FOR THE OPERATION OF LA MIRADA TRANSIT - It is recommended the City Council award a contract to MV Transportation, Inc. for the operation of La Mirada Transit for an initial term of four years in the total base amount of $4,332,194 with an option of two additional two-year extensions; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and extensions on behalf of the City.
8.3 Contract with MV Transportation
8.4
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING MARCH 2024 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending March 2024.
8.4 Monthly Treasurer Report
8.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-08, CREEK PARK VEHICLE BRIDGE REPLACEMENT – APPROVAL OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH SOUTHSTAR ENGINEERING & CONSULTING, INC. FOR PROFESSIONAL ENGINEERING SERVICES– It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute an Amendment to the On-Call Professional Services Agreement between the City of La Mirada and Southstar Engineering & Consulting, Inc. to provide professional engineering services for CIP No. 2021-08, Creek Park Vehicle Bridge Replacement, based on the Southstar Engineering & Consulting, Inc. proposal dated April 15, 2024, in the amount of $347,640.
8.5 CIP No. 2021-08
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 24-09 ADOPTING THE PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 BUDGET - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 24-09 approving the Proposed Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget.
PH: Reso. No. 24-09
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 24-10 APPROVING A RATE ADJUSTMENT FOR REFUSE SERVICE AND ESTABLISHING RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL REFUSE RATES IN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 24-10 approving the proposed rate adjustment and establishing residential and commercial refuse rates in the City of La Mirada effective July 1, 2024.
9.2 PH: Reso. No. 24-10
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
RESOLUTION NO. 24-11 ESTABLISHING THE APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 – It is recommended the City Council select the percentage change in the California Per Capita Personal Income as the inflation factor for Fiscal Year 2024-25; select the growth of the Couty as the population factor for Fiscal Year 2024-25; and adopt Resolution No. 24-11 establishing an Appropriations Limit for Fiscal Year 2024-25 pursuant to Article XIIIB of the California Constitution.
10.1 Reso. No. 24-11
SUCCESSOR AGENCY

11.1
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the Successor Agency approve the warrant register dated June 11, 2024 in the total amount of $8,015.00.
